_help: Named scans for --custom. Each filter is [field, operation, value]. A value that is a TradingView field name (e.g. "VWAP", "EMA20") compares the two fields. Operations: greater, less, egreater, eless, equal, nequal, in_range, not_in_range. Base filters (US stocks on NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX, primary listing, active) are always added.

trending.title: Trending after the open
trending.description: Up 3%+ from today's open on 2x+ intraday relative volume, above VWAP, RSI under 70 (not overbought).

trending_loose.title: Trending after the open (loosened)
trending_loose.description: Fallback when 'trending' finds fewer than 3 names: up 2%+ from the open on 1.5x+ intraday relative volume, above VWAP, RSI under 72.
